property.name: serializedAssets
property.label: Serialized Assets
property.description: Flat collection of serialized inventory assets from GetBundleComponentAssets

property.name: serializedProductQuantities
property.label: Serialized Product Quantities
property.description: JSON string of productId to quantity needed, from GetBundleComponentAssets

property.name: requireFullBundle
property.label: Require Full Bundle
property.description: When true (or unset), applies only to groups listed in optionalProductIds - they default fully pre-selected. Every other group is always fully pre-selected regardless of this value. Does not block proceeding either way - enforcement is a Flow Decision reading selectionIsComplete.

property.name: optionalProductIds
property.label: Optional Product Ids
property.description: JSON array of Product2 Ids that are deal-type-dependent (e.g. the laptop) rather than always-required, from GetBundleComponentAssets. Defaults to none optional if unset.

property.name: selectedAssets
property.label: Selected Assets
property.description: Assets selected by the user, output to Flow

property.name: selectionIsComplete
property.label: Selection Is Complete
property.description: True when every effectively-required group's selection count matches its quantityNeeded. A group listed in optionalProductIds is skipped when requireFullBundle is false. Read by a Flow Decision to enforce completeness.
